The XML entity decoder now performs one regex replacement with a callback. Encoded ampersands introduced in the result are not rescanned, preventing double-unescaping. Registry state is fixed.
The official-exceptions XML decoder uses the same single-pass callback rather than chained entity replacements. Nested encodings remain single-decoded. Registry state is fixed.

CUATM timeout and retry durations are reviewed constants: 60000 ms request timeout, two attempts and 3000 ms retry backoff. They are not supplied by an HTTP, environment or PR value. The uncontrolled-duration resource-exhaustion cause is absent; registry state is fixed.
OSM transport uses fixed 30000 ms API and 90000 ms Overpass timeouts, two retries and 5000 ms backoff. Timer durations are not taken from user input. Registry state is fixed.

Production host-trust audit callers explicitly supply a per-job runner.temp destination. This avoids the shared /tmp fallback in production. The review accepts the workflow use; it does not recommend the fallback for a hostile shared local host. Registry state is fixed.

Dynamic property names feed administrative numeric counters, not executable code or authorization. Registry state is fixed; the current PR has zero CodeQL results. No security suppression or source change is made in this remediation.
